scripts.dev:demo: npx kill-port 3000 4000 2>/dev/null || true && concurrently "npm run dev:demo:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:phone: npx kill-port 3000 4000 2>/dev/null || true && VITE_HOST=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null || echo '127.0.0.1') npm run dev:demo
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend
